Featured Project

Bio-inspired scaffolds from milkweed fibre

Jan – Apr 2026

Regenerative medicine, engineered from a natural fibre

A 3D porous scaffold built from milkweed fibre and a chitosan–gelatine blend, designed for tissue engineering applications.

  • NaOH treatment and genipin crosslinking to strengthen and stabilize the fibre network
  • Morphological, mechanical, FTIR, and biological characterization of the finished scaffold
  • Evaluated against porosity and cell-viability benchmarks relevant to regenerative medicine
